response.text: Summary: rewrote `src/csv.mjs`'s `parseCsv` with a character-by-character state machine supporting quoted fields (commas, newlines, doubled quotes), `\n`/`\r\n` line endings, and stripping one final trailing line end. Added `test/csv.test.mjs` with node:test coverage. `node --test` passes.
